# Third-party components

CasterLiveAutomation's original script sources are released under MIT.

AutoHotkey v2 is a separate open-source runtime released under GPL-2.0. Its interpreter is used by the `.ahk` scripts and may be incorporated into executables produced with Ahk2Exe. See [AutoHotkey](https://github.com/AutoHotkey/AutoHotkey), [Ahk2Exe](https://github.com/AutoHotkey/Ahk2Exe) and the included [GPL 2.0 text](GPL-2.0.txt).

Before distributing compiled executables, check applicable license obligations, retain copyright notices and provide corresponding sources and build instructions. **Do not assume the MIT license on the project sources replaces the AutoHotkey runtime license.** No third-party CasterLive DJ binaries are included.
